read.rule: read when NCC to the best class >= scoreMin and its margin over the best other class >= marginMin; else unread (?)

calibration.unit: NCC -1..1; margin = own-class NCC - best other-class NCC
calibration.sharpening: fn.q.sprite.overlap not applied: the training glyphs are pixel-identical renders (looOwnMin above), nothing to sharpen at this size
